title: Diagonal lemma (Russell / barber / relational Cantor)
conclusion_ve: not (there exists point x0, (for every point x1, ((if (x0 lists x1), then (not (x1 lists x1))) and (if (not (x1 lists x1)), then (x0 lists x1))))).
conclusion_fluent: it is false that (there is a point P such that for every point P2, both (if P lists P2 then P2 does not list P2) and (if P2 does not list P2 then P lists P2))
